items.title: 67256_Paul L. Howard oral history interview
items.q: [MR. Callender] Witnesses? >> [INTERVIEWEE] Witnesses, yeah. Eight or nine of them.

ctx.x: Witnesses, yeah. Eight or nine of them. And they was raising hell. And I'll think of the judge's name pretty soon. But he looked down there and said, "Hey you, come here." That's just the way he said it. I walked up there and I was scared to death. He said, "Weren't you out to my house last night with Mr. Howdy McVey?" That's what they called him, Howdy McVey. I said, "Yes, I was. I played at your house last night." "You play all that good music and you've got all these people here? What are you doing? What are…
forget it. Get out of here. Get out of the courtroom." Well, boy, that never got out of this town. Lots of people --
